name: yt-data-extractor
description: Turn a YouTube topic into real demand signals — autocomplete demand, the ranked SERP with full stats, and a one-video deep read (metadata + comments + transcript). Quota-aware Next.js + React 19 tool, live demo.

paragraphs: A research tool that reads YouTube three ways: what people actually search (autocomplete demand), who ranks for a term (the anonymous SERP with full stats), and everything about one video (metadata + top comments + full transcript). One topic in, structured JSON out — the raw material for deciding what to make and how to title it.

Built as the research engine behind my own content pipeline — before scripting a video I mine the real search demand, reverse-engineer the ranking incumbents, and pull transcripts of what already works. It's a deliberately small, sharp tool: three endpoints, no database, quota-aware by design. The category is validated — teams pay a monthly SaaS to do exactly this job.
